title: Hoya reportedly unable to meet Samsung's full 2027 EUV mask blank request
html:
Semiconductor mask blanks and photomasks produced by Hoya. Credit: Hoya Corporation

Japan's Hoya has reportedly told Samsung Electronics it would struggle to meet the chipmaker's request for additional extreme ultraviolet (EUV) mask blanks in 2027.
